Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen. title: Werkstudent Video Editor / Cutter Social Media (m/w/d)
description: Du studierst, schneidest in deiner Freizeit schon Reels und Sport ist fester Teil deines Lebens? Wir sind GORNATION, eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt, von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Auf Instagram erreichen wir über 270.000 Menschen. Damit unser Short Form Output weiter wächst, suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Content- und Social-Media-Team. Als Werkstudent schneidest du Reels, Shorts und TikToks für Organic & Paid Social und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Dabei sammelst du echte Praxis mit Content, der live geht und performt. Wir planen langfristig: Unser Ziel ist, dass du nach deinem Abschluss 2027 voll bei uns einsteigst. Arbeitsmodell: 15–20 Stunden/Woche, flexibel planbar rund um deine Vorlesungen, vor Ort in Münster. Start ab sofort, mit der Perspektive auf eine Übernahme in Vollzeit 2027. Aufgaben Organic Content schneiden: Aus Rohmaterial, Athleten-Content, Shootings, UGC und Produktvideos machst du Reels, Shorts und TikToks für unsere Kanäle. Paid Ads umsetzen: Du schneidest Ad Creatives, mit unterschiedlichen Hooks, Längen, Seitenverhältnissen und Texteinblendungen. Außerdem passt du Videos für unseren Onlineshop an. Feedback umsetzen: Du stimmst dich eng mit Social Media, Content und Marketing ab und setzt Anpassungen schnell und sauber um. Trends scouten: Du beobachtest Sounds, Schnittstile und Formate und bringst passende Ideen für GORNATION ein. Drehs begleiten: Du unterstützt bei Shootings und filmst Reels, Ads und Behind-the-Scenes Clips mit Smartphone oder Kamera. Footage organisieren: Du sichtest, benennst und archivierst Material, damit das Team jederzeit schnell darauf zugreifen kann. Qualifikation Studium mit Abschluss 2027: Du bist an einer Universität oder Hochschule eingeschrieben und schließt dein Studium voraussichtlich im Laufe des nächsten Jahres ab. Ein Studium im Bereich Medien, Film oder Kommunikation ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Langfristige Perspektive: Du kannst dir vorstellen, nach dem Studium in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen. Sportbegeisterung: Du hast einen starken Bezug zu Sport, idealerweise zu Calisthenics oder Kraftsport. Du erkennst eine saubere Ausführung, weißt, welche Moves beeindrucken, und setzt Athleten so in Szene, dass die Community es feiert. Erste Editing-Erfahrung: Eigene Kanäle, Uni-Projekte oder Freelance-Jobs zählen genauso wie Berufserfahrung. Editing Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit CapCut oder ähnlichen Programmen. Gespür für Short Form: Du weißt, wie ein starker Hook aussieht, schneidest dynamisch statt nur schnell und kannst einschätzen, ob ein Video performt. Zuverlässigkeit & Struktur: Du hältst Deadlines und Absprachen ein und arbeitest sauber, auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch, sodass du Captions und Texteinblendungen sicher umsetzen kannst. Lernbereitschaft: Du nimmst Feedback gerne an und willst dich im Editing konstant weiterentwickeln. Nice-to-have: Du filmst sicher mit der Kamera und hast Erfahrung im Schnitt von YouTube-Videos. Außerdem sind After Effects, Motion Design, Photoshop, Canva oder Asana ein Plus. Benefits Klare Perspektive: Wir stellen dich mit dem Ziel ein, dich nach deinem Abschluss in Vollzeit zu übernehmen. Flexible Planung: Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir auf deinen Stundenplan und deine Prüfungsphasen ab. Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder im Office-Gym oder draußen. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Sport-Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben Teamevents lernst du internationale Calisthenics-Athleten kennen. FIBO erleben: Mit einem 4-Tage-Ticket bist du auf der internationalen Fitnessmesse in Köln dabei. Exklusive Rabatte: Du bekommst Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser Equipment und unsere Kleidung. Office-Extras: Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische, Kaffee- und Wasser-Flat, hundefreundliches Büro nach Absprache und eine E-Auto-Ladestation am Campus. Du willst neben dem Studium Content schneiden, der wirklich gesehen wird und danach bei uns durchstarten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns 3-5 Beispiele deiner Reels, Shorts oder TikToks, gerne auch private Projekte, und nenn uns deinen voraussichtlichen Abschlusstermin. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo. 

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team and help shape how Addepar goes to market across EMEA, LATAM and APAC. You will become a trusted expert on the buyers, segments, market dynamics, competitive landscapes and regional nuances that influence how we position Addepar and engage prospects and clients in each market.

You’ll work closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams, along with Product and other go-to-market partners, to translate market insight into differentiated positioning, campaigns, enablement and launch strategies. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a product marketer who can connect Addepar’s global platform narrative to the distinct needs, use cases and product availability of each region.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute product marketing strategies for clients and prospects across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, aligned with company and platform priorities.
  • Build deep market expertise by understanding regional buyers, buying committees, client needs, competitive dynamics and cultural nuances.
  • Partner closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams to identify priorities and develop coordinated go-to-market programs.
  • Define regional positioning and messaging that connects Addepar’s global value proposition to the needs of prospective buyers and existing clients.
  • Adapt broader product launches for regional audiences and product availability, while owning end-to-end launches for region-specific capabilities.
  • Develop campaigns that generate awareness and demand among prospects while supporting engagement, adoption and expansion among clients.
  • Create scalable content and enablement, monitor program performance and use market and stakeholder feedback to continually strengthen our approach.

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience. Experience with B2B SaaS, financial services, fintech, wealth management or investment management is preferred.
  • Full-stack product marketer with experience across market research, positioning, messaging, launches, campaigns, enablement and content.
  • Experience adapting go-to-market strategies for different markets, audiences or customer needs; direct experience in every region is not required.
  • Excellent storyteller, writer and communicator who can translate sophisticated capabilities into clear customer value.
  • Strong cross-functional partner who can build trusted relationships with regional Sales, Marketing, Relationship Management and Product teams.
  • Globally minded and curious, with the judgment to balance a consistent global narrative with meaningful regional differences.
  • Comfortable working independently across multiple priorities, collaborating across time zones and traveling internationally as needed.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to

Du analysierst Störungen, konfigurierst Firewalls, Switches und Access Points und betreust Netzwerkumgebungen unterschiedlicher Kunden. Dadurch sammelst Du in kurzer Zeit deutlich mehr praktische Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Herstellern und Umgebungen als in einer klassischen Inhouse-IT.

Als Teil unseres Support-Teams bist Du Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen, unterstützt unseren Service Desk bei tiefergehenden Fragen und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Support Engineers zusammen. Du musst noch kein Netzwerk-Profi sein – erste praktische Erfahrung reicht. Wir bauen Dein Wissen gemeinsam durch Einarbeitung, Wissenstransfer und Herstellerzertifizierungen aus.

Aufgaben

  • Annahme, Analyse und Bearbeitung von Störungen und Anfragen im Bereich Netzwerk und Firewall per Telefon, E-Mail und Ticketsystem
  • Konfiguration und Betreuung von Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall, Fortinet FortiGate) – Regelwerke, NAT, VPN
  • Administration von Netzwerkkomponenten wie Switches und Access Points (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi, Fortinet oder Sophos)
  • Einrichtung und Support von Site-to-Site- und Client-VPN-Verbindungen
  • Analyse von Netzwerkproblemen (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Routing) gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden
  • Dokumentation von Konfigurationen, Änderungen und Lösungen
  • Unterstützung unseres Service Desks als fachlicher Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Support Engineers bei komplexeren Themen und Projekten
  • arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder in der Systemadministration
  • Grundverständnis von Netzwerken (TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, DNS, DHCP)
  • erste praktische Erfahrung mit Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall oder Fortinet FortiGate) und/oder Netzwerkkomponenten (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi)
  • gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Windows Client-Betriebssystemen
  • Freude an der Analyse technischer Probleme und Interesse, Dich im Netzwerk- und Security-Umfeld zu spezialisieren
  • Service- und kundenorientiertes Denken
  • selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Systemhaus- oder MSP-Umfeld
  • Kenntnisse in Sophos Central, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer oder UniFi Network Controller
  • Herstellerzertifizierungen (z. B. Sophos Certified Engineer, Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA)
  • Grundkenntnisse in Windows-Server-Umgebungen, Active Directory oder Microsoft 365
  • erste Berührungspunkte mit Virtualisierung (Hyper-V oder VMware)
  • ITIL-Kenntnisse oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

Das erwartet Dich

  • ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Kunden, Herstellern und Netzwerkumgebungen
  • gezielte fachliche Spezialisierung im Bereich Firewall, Netzwerk und IT-Security

description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

Customer Success Consultant - Mirakl Ads (Munich)

About the role

Launched three years ago, Mirakl Ads is Mirakl's global Retail Media technology, empowering eCommerce and Marketplace operators to run successful and profitable Retail Media programs. Now entering a new phase of scale, Mirakl Ads is expanding its client base, developing its media offering, and accelerating its impact across key markets worldwide.

As an Experienced Customer Success Consultant for Mirakl Ads, reporting to the Director of Customer Success, your primary mission is to support Mirakl Ads clients in launching and growing their advertising revenues - from strategy design to day-to-day performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.

 

What you will do at Mirakl

The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.

  • Lead clients from strategy to implementation: define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond
  • Deliver strategic recommendations at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth
  • Design and implement the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers
  • Support clients in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues
  • Lead tailored workshops and training sessions to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time

 

As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement and industrialization of Customer Success processes and tooling, ensuring scalable and efficient operations as the Mirakl Ads client base grows. Collaborate with BI teams to analyze client activity and monitor advertising network performance
  • Leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance the way we deliver value to clients and scale our operations - from automating reporting and insights generation to accelerating strategic recommendations and improving the overall client experience
  • Act internally as the voice of the Publisher, providing Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams with actionable insights on how Mirakl Ads fits and solves client needs at scale
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics in the Retail Media industry, translating intelligence into strategic recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Contribute your vision in meetings with adtech partners to strengthen Mirakl's positioning in the adtech value chain and support the growth of our global Advertising Services initiative

 

What Mirakl is looking for

  • Master's Degree in Business or Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience in retail media, the eCommerce industry, or in a consulting firm with strong exposure to digital advertising and/or marketplace ecosystems
  • Solid knowledge of eCommerce, marketplace, and online advertising, with a strong understanding of adtech value chains
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong client-facing and project management skills
  • Highly business-driven with strong analytical skills, thriving in dynamic environments
  • Someone eager to thrive in a scaling business environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of the Mirakl Ads Customer Success practice
  • Fluency in English is a must-have; German and/or French is a strong asset, given our key markets.
  • Self-motivated and energetic, with experience managing multiple internal stakeholders to deliver commercial goals
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Willingness to travel internationally

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

title: Senior AI Search engineer(m/f/x)
description:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.
  • Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.
  • Analyze user needs and discuss technical approaches.
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps.
  • Take part in on-call rotations with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer working in search.
  • Experience with building search solutions on top of engines, such as Elasticsearch (preferred), Solr, OpenSearch, or similar.
  • Aspiration to constantly improve yourself and learn new technologies, concepts, etc.
  • Fluent English communication skills to work in international teams.
  • AI Aptitude: A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience using modern search stacks and strategies to optimize search relevance (Vector and Hybrid Search, Learning to rank, Re-ranker)
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures (incl., queues, notification topics, sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover).
  • Experience working with Scala or other functional programming languages.
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust. 

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success 

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. 

For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page.

Join our mission, join Doctolib!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin.
To give the best experience to Doctolibers and support Doctolib’s growth, you will help manage our IT stock and asset base, including laptops, smartphones and accessories. Reporting to the IT team, you will own the reliability of our hardware inventory and contribute to day-to-day on-site support in an international environment across Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.

What you’ll do

As a Working Student, you will support us in the following areas:
IT stock and asset management — approximately 70%
  • Manage the site’s IT stock, including receiving, checking, labelling and storing laptops, smartphones and accessories
  • Keep the inventory up to date in our asset management tool and ensure the accuracy of serial numbers, assignments and statuses
  • Follow the full equipment lifecycle, including assignment, return, loan, vendor repair, refurbishment and recycling
  • Run periodic physical inventories and consistency checks between physical stock and the asset management tool
  • Monitor stock levels, flag replenishment thresholds and contribute to supplier orders
  • Prepare devices, including mobile device management enrolment, standard configuration and accessory kits
  • Propose improvements to stock processes, documentation, automation and key performance indicators
On-site support — approximately 30%
  • Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing, handing over and recovering equipment for joiners and leavers
  • Run the Berlin IT Corner as a physical point of contact for Doctolibers
  • Manage meeting room hardware by testing, updating and replacing equipment
  • Handle level 1 requests and incidents, including basic diagnosis and application access, and escalate to level 2 when needed

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role

As a senior member of the Data team, you will build the services, infrastructure and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products. This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering. You will develop scalable backend services, design and maintain data pipelines and build the underlying data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing. 

You'll work closely with other engineering teams, data consumers and infrastructure specialists to build robust solutions that balance technical excellence with delivering business value. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organisation, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management. 

This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that support data ingestion, processing and distribution. 
  • Build and maintain reliable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data from a wide variety of internal and external sources. 
  • Develop reusable frameworks and tooling that simplify onboarding new data sources and improve developer productivity. 
  • Design and optimise scalable data platforms including databases, data lakes, metadata catalogues and storage solutions. 
  • Continuously improve the reliability, scalability, observability and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure. 
  • Integrate data across multiple systems while reducing duplication and ensuring high data quality. 
  • Develop and maintain orchestration workflows and automated data processing pipelines. 
  • Build internal libraries and services that enable other engineering teams to access and consume data efficiently. 
  • Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise production systems and data pipelines. 
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions across the data platform. 
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data engineers, infrastructure engineers and data consumers to deliver high-impact solutions. 
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify systems, improve automation and reduce operational overhead. 

 

About You

This person will be an experienced Senior Data Engineer with hands-on backend development experience. We hope this person will have ambitions to develop their technical knowledge within Commodity Trading, by developing and maintaining in-house systems using the latest technology stack. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can make pragmatic engineering decisions that maximise impact. 

As a result, the following experiences and skills are essential for application:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building production backend systems in the financial services industry.
  • Professional experience developing applications and services using Python in the financial services industry.
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines or large-scale data processing systems.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Experience working with containerised applications and modern software delivery practices.
  • Familiarity with messaging and asynchronous processing patterns.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, testing and maintainability.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Strong ownership mentality with the ability to prioritise work based on business impact.

In addition, the following is not required, but highly desirable for this role:

  • Experience working in a Commodities Trading House or Hedge Fund.
  • Experience building services using FastAPI or similar modern Python frameworks.
  • Experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and cloud-native architectures.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and high-throughput data processing.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and participation in Engelhart’s discretionary bonus plan.
  • 28 days of annual holiday entitlement plus Berlin public holidays.
  • €3,000 per year contribution to a private pension scheme on your behalf.
  • €20 monthly subsidy towards BVG tickets.
  • €25 monthly subsidy towards ClassPass membership.
  • A subsidy for German language courses to help you immerse yourself in the local culture.
  • A sociable working environment with an open, international culture.

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish

Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role: 

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

  • Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
  • Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
  • Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
  • Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
  • Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
  • Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

  • Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
  • Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
  • Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
  • Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

  • Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
  • Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
  • Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
  • Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster — they are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.

Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity — turning months of simulation into days, and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.

We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a leader who combines deep technical understanding of engineering workflows with the strategic vision and influence to drive large-scale AI transformation in some of the world's most sophisticated engineering organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial strategy. As SE Lead, you will own the pre-sales motion on the region's most strategic accounts — leading discovery, shaping transformation plans alongside Sales, and delivering the technical vision that convinces both engineers and executives that NC is the right long-term partner.

You will also build and develop the regional SE team, setting the bar for what excellent pre-sales work looks like: rigorous discovery, technically grounded statements of work, and demos that don't just impress but inspire confidence in a real engineering future.

Your work will directly shape how Neural Concept wins in the region.

What You'll Do

  • Position NC as a long-term strategic partner and trusted engineering advisor on the region's most strategic accounts, building trusted relationships with engineering leadership and senior stakeholders

  • Lead structured discovery sessions on strategic accounts, framing use cases that are technically feasible and commercially grounded

  • Define the AI strategy and technical roadmap across the regional portfolio, translating NC's capabilities and product direction into credible, customer-specific multi-horizon visions

  • Create and deliver compelling, client-tailored demos and presentations grounded in the client's engineering workflows, technically credible and aligned with the vision

  • Create and co-own the Statement of Work, with deep understanding of the technical building blocks and how these transform the client's existing workflows

  • Prepare and run Steering Committees on strategic accounts, connecting engineering challenges to strategic outcomes

  • Identify expansion and growth opportunities across the regional portfolio, and shape them into well-scoped proposals

  • Lead and develop the regional SE team, setting high standards for discovery quality, demo impact, and SoW accuracy; orchestrate account assignment, manage capacity, and serve as the escalation point on the region's most complex deals

  • Collaborate with the Sales team to advance and close strategic deals, with the Forward Deployed Engineering team to ensure smooth pre-sales to delivery transitions, and surface client insights to Product and R&D to inform roadmap priorities

Who You Are

  • You hold an engineering degree (mechanical, aerospace, automotive, industrial, or similar) and have strong hands-on experience with CAD and CAE workflows, including where bottlenecks lie and what it takes to transform those workflows with AI

  • You are naturally curious and people-driven. You earn trust at every level, from simulation engineers to VPs, through genuine interest in their challenges and make people feel understood

  • You are proactive and commercially driven. You move accounts and teams forward without being asked, spot opportunities early, and bring structure to ambiguous situations

  • You are a confident challenger. You ask uncomfortable questions, reframe assumptions, and guide both clients and your team toward better outcomes even when it requires pushing back

  • You are an outstanding communicator: equally comfortable in a hands-on technical deep-dive with simulation engineers and a strategic roadmap discussion with a VP of Engineering or CTO

  • You are a proven people leader. You build high-performing teams, elevate individual performance, give honest feedback, and create the environment where SEs do their best work and grow fast

  • You have 8+ years of experience in a senior technical client-facing role: solutions engineering, pre-sales, technical consulting, or similar, with a track record on complex, high-value accounts

  • Professional fluency in German and English.

What Will Set You Apart

  • You have hands-on simulation experience: full pipelines from CAD to post-processing, solver experience, and workflow automation

  • You are a strong programmer: you write clean Python, build data pipelines, and are comfortable in ML/DL frameworks including model training, evaluation, and deployment

  • You can go deep in technical discovery: dive into customer toolchains, data environments, and simulation setups to assess feasibility at the level a simulation engineer would respect

  • You can build end-to-end engineering workflow demos from scratch, rapidly prototyping the full arc from design generation and simulation to application deployment

  • You have experience structuring and proposing enterprise transformation programs, not just individual projects but multi-year adoption roadmaps

  • You have experience building or leading technical pre-sales or solutions engineering teams, or come from a strategic or technical consulting background

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description: Über uns Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Das gibt es zu tun Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft. Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen. Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus Was uns wichtig ist Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich. Das bekommst Du Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt. AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. Du kannst aktiv zuhören, gezielt nachfragen und zwischen einem netten Gespräch und einer relevanten Geschäftschance unterscheiden. Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und konsequent – auch wenn mehrere Kontakte und nächste Schritte parallel laufen. Du bist freundlich hartnäckig und hast ein gutes Gespür für Timing, Tonalität und den richtigen nächsten Schritt. Du gehst sicher mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Arbeitsmitteln um. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du interessierst dich für künstliche Intelligenz, digitale Geschäftsmodelle und die Frage, wie Technologie messbaren Mehrwert für Organisationen schafft. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Ideen ein und setzt sie pragmatisch um. Du hast Lust auf Tempo, Wachstum und ein Umfeld, in dem dein Beitrag unmittelbar sichtbar wird. Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt, erkennst dich aber in der Rolle wieder? Dann möchten wir trotzdem von dir hören. Wir suchen keine perfekte Checkliste, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufbauen und bewegen will. Was wir bieten Gestaltungsfreiheit statt Dienst nach Vorschrift Du übernimmst keinen fertig zementierten Prozess. Du kannst unseren Inside-Sales-Ansatz aktiv mitgestalten, Abläufe verbessern und deine Ideen direkt in die Praxis bringen. Wirkung statt Warteschleife Deine Arbeit verschwindet nicht in Präsentationen oder endlosen Abstimmungsrunden. Aus deinen Kontakten entstehen Gespräche, Geschäftschancen und neue Kundenbeziehungen. Dein Beitrag ist unmittelbar sichtbar. Verantwortung ab Tag eins Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und steuerst Prioritäten, Kontakte und Follow-ups selbstständig. Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du Entscheidungen triffst, Initiative zeigst und Themen voranbringst. KI mit Substanz Du verkaufst keine kurzlebige Spielerei. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das Organisationen grundlegend verändert: dem sicheren, souveränen und skalierbaren Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz über Daten, Prozesse und Systeme hinweg. Lernen im Zukunftsmarkt Du entwickelst dein Verständnis für KI-Anwendungen, digitale Geschäftsmodelle, komplexe Kundenbedarfe und moderne Vertriebsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Entwicklung mit neuland.ai Wenn neuland.ai wächst, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich. Perspektivisch kannst du dich beispielsweise in Richtung Key Account Management, Business Development, Partner Management oder Sales Consulting weiterentwickeln. Flexibilität und digitale Zusammenarbeit Wir setzen auf eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, digitale Prozesse und eine flexible Organisation des Arbeitsalltags im Rahmen unserer betrieblichen Möglichkeiten. Eine Kultur, die zu unserem Namen passt neuland bedeutet für uns: neugierig bleiben, mutig ausprobieren und Verantwortung übernehmen. Wir arbeiten offen, direkt und pragmatisch zusammen. title: Applied ML Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France. As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering. You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products. The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences. You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate. You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users. The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack. It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust. Accountabilities Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models. Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses. Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required. Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility. Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows. Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion. Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations. Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses. Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation. Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve. During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations. Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface. Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility. Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages. Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation. Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate. Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users. Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests. High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently. Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions. Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus. Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous. Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial. Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus. Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable. Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage. A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend. Benefits: Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product. End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences. Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques. raw.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.


Accountabilities
  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.

  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given. raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

  • You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

  • You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

  • You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

  • Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

  • Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

  • Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

  • Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

  • Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

  • Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

  • Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

  • Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

  • Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

  • Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

  • Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

Experience and technical skills

  • 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

  • Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

  • Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

  • Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

  • Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range.
